body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete

GO:0016410 N-acyltransferase activity

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31814

To be replaced by GO:0016747 acyltransferase activity, transferring groups other than amino-acyl groups

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1s6OOzw6d4lqodusf2LcM66v_xgWvHutXZavSf3hf1GI/edit?gid=0#gid=0
